final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_ig_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ig_diff) AS overall_avg FROM patient_groups), ratios AS (SELECT g.SEX, g.avg_pt, g.avg_ig_diff / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM patient_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_group_pt, (SELECT AVG(avg_ig_diff) FROM patient_groups AS g2 WHERE g2.SEX IS ratios.SEX) AS avg_group_ig_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios GROUP BY SEX
